title: SAML2 metadata forensics + guided remediation workflow
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a metadata 'forensics' investigator as part of the SAML 2.0 setup flow that collects, validates, and proposes guided fixes for malformed or incompatible IdP metadata. The focus is on signature provenance checks, schema and protocol diffs, certificate validity reconciliation, and emitting structured audit events for RBAC v2 and admin review. This ticket ties together: the interactive setup UX (wizard), backend validation service, audit-log enrichment, and an operator remediation runbook.
acceptance_criteria: Setup flow invokes metadata-forensics service when a user uploads/pastes IdP metadata or provides an entity URL
Service returns deterministic issues with severity (error/warning/info) and suggested remediation steps for each issue
Signature chain validation reports original signer, certificate thumbprints, and expiration, and flags use of weak algorithms
Schema diffing highlights fields that will break Redwood's SAML implementation (NameID formats, attribute mappings, binding mismatches)
Audit log entries are emitted for every validation run with sufficient context for RBAC v2-level admin queries (connector_id, user_id, validation_result_hash)
Admin console shows a remediation checklist and allows apply/fix actions (e.g., enforce entityID normalization, override attribute mapping) gated by RBAC v2 permissions
End-to-end tests cover 8 real-world IdP samples (Okta, OneLogin, ADFS, Azure AD, Keycloak, Shibboleth, PingFederate, ForgeRock) with expected pass/fail outcomes

implementation_notes: Service exposes REST endpoint /validate-metadata that returns a flat list of issue codes and remediation snippets
Store validation_result_hash in audit logs to allow quick lookup without saving full metadata payload
Add RBAC v2 permission 'saml.connector.remediate' for actions that modify stored connector config
Rate-limit remote metadata fetches and enable SSRF-safe resolver (resolve via sandboxed worker with IP whitelist)
Prefer existing sso-utils parsing library; add small wrapper for structured output used by console and logs
test_plan: Unit tests for certificate parsing and thumbprint calculation
Integration tests: wizard -> forensics service -> apply remediation (mocked) in staging
Security tests: SSRF fuzzing and signed metadata replay tests
Manual QA: walkthrough with 8 IdP samples and admin remediation flow
rollout_plan: Beta rollout to 10 pilot customers for feedback
Collect telemetry on most common validation issues for 30 days before enabling suggested auto-fix prompts
Post-launch: schedule security audit and capture logs for incident response readiness
